CI/CD — the one enforced pipeline every green unit crosses to reach trunk

The orchestrator's own context window becomes an occupancy series in its session trace
Desktop client — a trusted member runs the whole storytree loop on their own machine, credential in the OS keychain

Feedback graduation — linked feedback is routed by the graduation synthesist
The forest-world render core — the shared deterministic geometry both surfaces draw from
Review mode — a word-processor collaboration layer for library documents
The Library as a tech-tree drawer over the forest map
Mintbox event-driven orchestration — fresh Astra decisions, sustained Terra execution
The notice board is the claim ledger — one deterministic record coordinates parallel sessions and powers every observability surface
Proof-binding integrity — every machine UAT leg is evidence or a visible refusal
The proof-protocol port — the shared verdict vocabulary at the root of the graph
The storage-protocol port — the universal document-event storage seam every organism persists through
Studio cloud — the trusted circle interacts with a served studio
Studio members — real accounts, roles, and invitations from the UI
The embedded terminal opens in a repo the user picks — thread the selected working directory through the Electron main
The embedded terminal is multi-session with a VS Code-style session panel — a seed opens a FRESH tab, never the user's active Claude Code session
UAT attestation — each UAT test earns green by its witness; a vouch never forges a green
A UAT criterion's detail is a live-canonical Library artifact — pointed-to, hash-anchored, and authorable with the hierarchy
Studio UAT criterion rows stay one-line and open the Library detail
The public website — the consuming surface that draws the forest-world look from the synced render core
The two-act vibe-coding experience — the public site's front door enacts chaos → calm
